scriptEn.hook: Three stories the whole world is talking about. Sixty seconds each.

stories.headline: NASA's quiet supersonic jet, the X-59, just broke the sound barrier
stories.summary: On June 5th, NASA's experimental X-59 flew faster than sound for the very first time, reaching Mach 1.1 high above California. The jet is built to turn the loud sonic boom into a soft thump. If it works, it could end a fifty-year ban and bring supersonic passenger flights back over land.

keyword.definitionEn: faster than the speed of sound

stories.commentQuestion: Would you fly supersonic if tickets cost double?

stories.headline: The biggest World Cup ever kicks off, with 48 teams and three host nations
stories.summary: The 2026 World Cup opens on June 11th, when Mexico face South Africa at the famous Estadio Azteca. For the first time the tournament has 48 teams and is co-hosted by three countries, the United States, Canada, and Mexico. Tiny Curacao even became the smallest nation ever to qualify.

keyword.definitionEn: a country or city that holds and organizes an event

stories.commentQuestion: Which team are you backing this World Cup?

stories.headline: After 144 years, Barcelona's Sagrada Familia becomes the world's tallest church
stories.summary: Barcelona's Sagrada Familia has finally finished its central tower, rising 172.5 meters to become the tallest church on Earth. Work began all the way back in 1882. A blessing is planned for June 10th, exactly one hundred years after the architect Antoni Gaudi died. Even so, the whole basilica will not be done until around 2034.
stories.commentQuestion: Would you wait 144 years to finish one building?

todaysWord.definitionEn: faster than the speed of sound
todaysWord.definitionJp: 超音速の（音速より速い）

scriptEn.close: That's three big stories shaping the world right now. Follow for more.

scriptJp.hook: 今、世界が注目する3つの話題。

stories.headline: NASAの静かな超音速機X-59、初めて音速を突破
stories.summary: 6月5日、NASAの実験機X-59がカリフォルニア上空で初めて音速を超え、マッハ1.1を記録。ソニックブームを小さな音に変える設計で、陸上での超音速旅客便が50年ぶりに戻る可能性。

stories.headline: 史上最大のW杯が開幕、48カ国・3カ国共催
stories.summary: 2026年W杯が6月11日開幕。開幕戦はメキシコ対南アフリカ、舞台は名門エスタディオ・アステカ。初の48カ国・米加墨の3カ国共催で、最小出場国キュラソーも話題に。

stories.headline: 144年かけて、サグラダ・ファミリアが世界一高い教会に
stories.summary: バルセロナのサグラダ・ファミリアが中央塔を172.5mで完成させ、世界一高い教会に。着工は1882年。6月10日にガウディ没後100年の祝福が予定。全体の完成は2034年頃の見込み。
